name: tiled_scale_multidim feathered tile accumulation
plain: Core tile engine for VAE and upscalers. It runs the function on overlapping tiles and accumulates with a linear edge feather, dividing by the accumulated mask. Because the feather applies on all tile edges and divides out, this is a normalised overlap-add, not a seamless (circular) tiling method.
math:
mask at distance t from tile edge = (t+1)/feather, feather = round(scale·overlap), multiplied per axis
out = Σ(tile·mask) / Σ(mask)
positions step = tile−overlap
